from collections import Counter, defaultdict
def f(Ic):
    H,W=len(Ic),len(Ic[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in Ic for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    O=[row[:] for row in Ic]
    seen=set(); shapes=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            x=Ic[r][c]
            if x==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            comp={(r,c)}; st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c))
            while st:
                q=st.pop()
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p=(q[0]+dx,q[1]+dy)
                    if 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W and Ic[p[0]][p[1]]==x and p not in comp:
                        comp.add(p); st.append(p)
            if len(comp)!=3: continue
            rs={p[0] for p in comp}; cs_={p[1] for p in comp}
            if max(rs)-min(rs)!=1 or max(cs_)-min(cs_)!=1: continue
            wins=[(rr,cc) for rr in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1) for cc in range(min(cs_),max(cs_)+1)]
            miss=[p for p in wins if p not in comp]
            if len(miss)==1:
                m=miss[0]
                C=None
                for p in comp:
                    n=sum(1 for a in [(p[0]+1,p[1]),(p[0]-1,p[1]),(p[0],p[1]+1),(p[0],p[1]-1)] if a in comp)
                    if n==2: C=p
                d=(m[0]-C[0], m[1]-C[1])
                shapes.append((x,m,d))
    for x,m,d in shapes:
        r,c=m
        while True:
            r+=d[0]; c+=d[1]
            if not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W): break
            if Ic[r][c]!=bg: break
            O[r][c]=x
    return O
